Aa Raha Hai Sham Ka Bazar Zainab Kya Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Sar Jhukaye Chal Rahi Hai Malka-e-Sharam-o-Haya
Chaar Janib Hain Sina Bardar Zainab Kya Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Koi Pathar Phainkta Hai Kholta Pani Koi
Ho Rahi Hai Zulm Ki Yalgar Zainab Kya Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Chadrein Sar Se Cheeni Khaimay Jalay Qaidi Banay
Lut Gaya Shabbir Ka Ghar Bar Kya Zainab Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Bagi Bagi Keh Ke Shami Hans Rahe Hain Aye Khuda
Ro Rahi Hai Itrat-e-Athar Zainab Kya Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Mangney Aaya Hai Bachi Ko Kaneezi Mein Laeen
Ab Tu Aa Jao Alambardar Zainab Kya Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Syed-e-Sajjad Qaidi Be Rida Ahl-e-Haram
Our Sharabi Ka Bhara Darbar Zainab Kya Kar
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Qasim-o-Akbar Nahi Shair-e-Dilawar Bhi Nahi
Mar Gaye Sab Monis-o-Ghamkhuwar Zainab Kya Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Bimar, Zainab Kya Karey
Bas Yehi Noha Tha YASIR, Zainab-e-Dilgeer Ka
Lut Gayi Shabbir Ki Sarkar Zainab Kya Karey
Kya Karey Aye Abid-e-Beemar Zainab Kya Karey
